methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T

K = capital to build it: $24.48B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.38 = $65.18B
σ = 27% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $13.78B
